rules.alternatives: Instead of 30 contact hours the nurse may choose one option: national certification/recertification in the practice role; a board-approved refresher course; 2 semester hours of post-licensure nursing education; or 15 contact hours plus one of: a nursing project as (co-)principal investigator, a published nursing article/book/chapter, ≥5 contact hours of presentations taught, or 640 hours of active practice in the last 2 years.
rules.audit_note: Licensees are audited at renewal/reinstatement; proof due by the last day of the renewal month; keep documentation 3 years.
rules.notes: Biennial renewal by the last day of the birth month. Each renewal also needs a self-assessment of practice and a learning plan. Active-duty military may be exempt.
